title: Degreewise middle maps between split horseshoe rows
statement:
Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let X, Y, Z and X', Y', Z' be
nonnegative cochain complexes. Let alpha: X to Y, beta: Y to Z, alpha': X' to Y',
and beta': Y' to Z' be chain maps, with both composites zero and both rows short
exact in every degree. Suppose every term of X and X' is injective
[def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Given chain maps phiA: X to X' and phiC: Z to Z',
there is a family t of degreewise maps Y to Y' such that alpha followed by t equals
phiA followed by alpha', and t followed by beta' equals beta followed by phiC,
in every degree. No differential compatibility is asserted for t.

source.place: Tag 0136, implication that a short exact sequence beginning with an injective splits; horseshoe naturality Step 1

proof.text: Choose source retractions r and target sections s by ShortExact.splittingOfInjective in each degree.

Set t to r followed by phiA followed by alpha' plus beta followed by phiC followed by s. Distribute composition over addition and use the splitting identities and the two zero composites to prove both outer squares.

lean.statement:
theorem horseshoe_degreewise_map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {X Y Z X' Y' Z' : CochainComplex C ℕ}
    (α : X ⟶ Y) (β : Y ⟶ Z) (α' : X' ⟶ Y') (β' : Y' ⟶ Z')
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0) (hαβ' : α' ≫ β' = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ n : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact)
    (hexact' : ∀ n : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α' β' hαβ').map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact)
    (hinj : ∀ n, Injective (X.X n)) (hinj' : ∀ n, Injective (X'.X n))
    (φA : X ⟶ X') (φC : Z ⟶ Z') :
    ∃ t : ∀ n, Y.X n ⟶ Y'.X n,
      (∀ n, α.f n ≫ t n = φA.f n ≫ α'.f n) ∧
      (∀ n, t n ≫ β'.f n = β.f n ≫ φC.f n)

blueprint_update.statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $X,Y,Z$ and $X',Y',Z'$ be cochain complexes of $\mathcal C$ concentrated in degrees $\ge0$. Let $\alpha:X\to Y$, $\beta:Y\to Z$, $\alpha':X'\to Y'$ and $\beta':Y'\to Z'$ be morphisms of complexes with $\alpha\beta=0$ and $\alpha'\beta'=0$ (composition written diagrammatically), such that the rows $0\to X^n\to Y^n\to Z^n\to0$ and $0\to X'^n\to Y'^n\to Z'^n\to0$ are short exact in every degree $n$. Suppose every term $X^n$ and $X'^n$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Given morphisms of complexes $\varphi_A:X\to X'$ and $\varphi_C:Z\to Z'$, there is a family $t=(t_n:Y^n\to Y'^n)_n$ of maps with $\alpha_nt_n=(\varphi_A)_n\alpha'_n$ and $t_n\beta'_n=\beta_n(\varphi_C)_n$ for every $n$. No compatibility of $t$ with the differentials is asserted.

proof.text: A short exact sequence whose first term is injective splits. So in each degree $n$ choose a retraction $r_n:Y^n\to X^n$ of $\alpha_n$ for the source row ($\alpha_nr_n=\mathrm{id}_{X^n}$, diagrammatic order) and a section $s_n:Z'^n\to Y'^n$ of $\beta'_n$ for the target row ($s_n\beta'_n=\mathrm{id}_{Z'^n}$).

Set $t_n=r_n(\varphi_A)_n\alpha'_n+\beta_n(\varphi_C)_ns_n$ ($r$ followed by $\varphi_A$ followed by $\alpha'$, plus $\beta$ followed by $\varphi_C$ followed by $s$). Distributing composition over addition and using the splitting identities and the two zero composites, $\alpha_nt_n=(\varphi_A)_n\alpha'_n+\alpha_n\beta_n(\varphi_C)_ns_n=(\varphi_A)_n\alpha'_n$ and $t_n\beta'_n=r_n(\varphi_A)_n\alpha'_n\beta'_n+\beta_n(\varphi_C)_n=\beta_n(\varphi_C)_n$, which are both outer squares.
